question: What is your return policy?
answer: Our return policy lasts 30 days from the purchase date with original receipt and tag intact.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: You can track your order using the tracking link sent in your email confirmation or via your account dashboard.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 100 countries worldwide. Shipping fees and delivery times vary by destination.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click on 'Forgot Password' at the login screen, enter your registered email address, and follow the password reset link.

question: What payment methods are accepted?
answer: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: Yes, you can update your shipping address within 1 hour of placing the order via your account dashboard.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days.

question: Is there a warranty on products?
answer: Yes, all electronic products come with a standard 1-year manufacturer warranty.

question: Do you have a mobile app?
answer: Yes, our app is available for download on both iOS App Store and Google Play Store.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach customer support via live chat on our website or by emailing support@example.com.

question: What is AWS Cloud?
answer: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a comprehensive cloud platform offering over 200 fully featured services from data centers globally.

question: How do I create an AWS account?
answer: Visit aws.amazon.com, click 'Create an AWS Account', and follow the step-by-step registration process.

question: What is Amazon EC2?
answer: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) provides resizable, secure virtual servers in the cloud.

question: What is Amazon S3?
answer: Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) is an object storage service offering industry-leading scalability, data availability, and security.

question: How do I secure my AWS account?
answer: Enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), use IAM roles instead of root credentials, and enforce strong password policies.

question: What is the student portal?
answer: The student portal is a centralized online platform where students access course materials, grades, schedules, and university announcements.

question: How do I log into the student portal?
answer: Go to portal.university.edu and log in using your student ID number and secret password.

question: How can I view my exam results?
answer: Log into the student portal and navigate to Academic History > Grades & Marks to view your semester results.

question: How do I register for courses?
answer: Course registration opens each semester under the 'Academics > Course Registration' tab in the student portal.

question: What should I do if I forget my student ID?
answer: Contact the Admissions or IT Helpdesk office with your registered national ID or email to recover your student ID.

question: How do I request a transcript?
answer: Submit a formal request under 'Student Services > Transcript Request' on the portal or visit the Registrar's Office.

question: What are the library opening hours?
answer: The university library is open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM and Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

question: Is Wi-Fi available on campus?
answer: Yes, high-speed campus Wi-Fi ('Campus-Student') is available using your student portal login credentials.

question: How do I apply for financial aid or scholarships?
answer: Check the 'Financial Aid' section on the portal or submit your application to the Student Welfare Department.

question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time from your Billing Settings page with no cancellation fee.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days back to your original payment method once approved.

question: How do I update my personal details?
answer: Log into your account settings, select 'Profile Information', update your details, and click Save.

question: Why am I not receiving notification emails?
answer: Check your Spam/Junk folder and make sure notifications@example.com is added to your safe senders list.

question: Is my data secure?
answer: Yes, all user data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256) following strict industry standards.
